Hello, my name is Priya Raman. I am a neurologist from Chennai, in India. I work at a university hospital, and my field is pain medicine. My main focus is nerve pain in patients with diabetes. I have been in this field for about twelve years. This is my third time at this congress, and every year I meet colleagues from countries I have never visited. That is the part I like most. I am here for the workshop on Wednesday, and I hope to hear about new research from South America.

Good morning, and welcome to the registration desk. If you are here for the World Congress on Pain, please have your confirmation email ready. Your badge has your name, your institution and your country on it. The workshop rooms are on the second floor, and the programme is in your bag. Coffee is served at ten thirty in the main hall, and that is the best moment to meet other researchers. If you need anything during the week, just look for a person with a blue badge. Enjoy the congress.
